headline: Philippines Central Bank Projects November Inflation at 7.2%-8.2%
summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas expects November inflation to reach 7.2%-8.2%, driven by rising electricity and LPG costs.
why: Inflation data is a primary driver for central bank interest rate decisions, which directly impact currency and bond markets.

impacts.name: Philippine Peso
impacts.why: High inflation erodes purchasing power and may pressure the currency.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Expectations of high inflation often lead to currency depreciation as real interest rates decline.
